name: IssueSecurityCard
srcDivergence: Merged from the file (`record-src-reconcile`), preview substitution kept. Two things were true at once here and they needed opposite treatment. BY CONSTRUCTION: the file reads state from `useAppStore()` and imports `ToggleRow` from a RELATIVE `../pages/SettingsControls`, neither of which a record can do — the preview has no app store, and a record may not carry a relative specifier — so the record keeps its local `useState` stand-in and its `@/components/togglerow` SIBLING import. GENUINELY STALE: the card's user-facing copy had been rewritten in the file and never reached the record, so the preview was showing out-of-date text. The file's render (title + description) is now taken verbatim while the substitution survives. Hand-merged, not copied.
